question: Should OpenClaw accept this first-party Control UI math-rendering path, and what dependency/vendor provenance and delimiter policy are required before merge?
rationale: The patch changes untrusted chat rendering behavior and adds first-party executable browser code, so automation cannot safely choose the product and security boundary.

options.title: Track dependency and narrow parsing
options.body: Replace the opaque bundle with reviewed package/build provenance and avoid `$...$` inline parsing by default while preserving explicit math delimiters.

options.title: Approve explicit vendoring
options.body: Accept a vendored MathJax asset only with documented version, source, license, update process, and owner-approved review provenance.

options.title: Defer to canonical issue
options.body: Keep this PR paused or close it later if maintainers decide the broader Control UI math-rendering direction should be solved by another candidate path.

recommendation.title: Track dependency and narrow parsing
recommendation.body: Replace the opaque bundle with reviewed package/build provenance and avoid `$...$` inline parsing by default while preserving explicit math delimiters.

likelyOwner.reason: He has original Control UI markdown history and adjacent CSP/Gateway security ownership signals for the decision surface.
